title: Season 2
overview: Loki navigates timeslipping and the impending collapse of the Temporal Loom across the multiverse.

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.overview: Loki finds himself slipping through time and seeks the help of OB in the TVA basement.

episodes.title: Breaking Brad
episodes.overview: Loki and Mobius track down hunter Brad Wolfe in London 1977 to locate Sylvie and General Dox before the timeline branches are pruned.
Loki and Mobius travel to the 1893 Chicago World's Fair tracking Ravonna Renslayer and Miss Minutes, discovering variant inventor Victor Timely.

episodes.title: Heart of the TVA
episodes.overview: The team attempts to use the Throughput Multiplier to fix the Temporal Loom before total catastrophic failure of the multiverse branches.

episodes.title: Science/Fiction
episodes.overview: After the Loom's destruction, Loki experiences spaghettification and timeslips across the multiverse to reassemble his friends and master his control over time.

episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: Loki learns the true nature of time, burdens himself with glorious purpose, and ascends the throne at the center of the multiverse.
